name: CuraScientific Corp
summary: Based in Coachella, California, CuraScientific Corp. was founded in 2020. The company focuses on the production, distribution, and retail of cannabis products, which are sold under the JW Brands and Chad Enterprises names. In addition to cannabis, its offerings extend to cannabidiol (CBD), kava, and kratom. Prior to April 2023, the company operated as Boon Industries, Inc. before adopting its current name.
